purpose: Document Tangail's official land-record custodian and inspect the current public Bangladesh map services for safe anonymous parcel geometry.
assessment: Tangail local/state land-record custody is evidenced by the official Tangail Zonal Settlement Office and DLRS settlement portal. The current public map.land.gov.bd viewer exposes anonymous administrative and geometry routes in JavaScript, but its division-30 district response omitted Tangail and configured GeoServer metadata returned HTTP 503. No parcel geometry was retained and no absence inference was made.
registryAssessment: Official local/state registry/cadastre custody is evidenced. This does not verify public parcel geometry, title, ownership, or citywide coverage.
